decisions.reason: As a publicly emphasized flagship stollen with a separate page, a gold-medal distinction, and strong fit with the firm's confectionery identity, management is very unlikely to reverse course within a year.

Although this rye variant remains somewhat exposed to assortment simplification after the earlier bread withdrawals, it still builds directly on core baking capabilities and prior launch commitment makes management inclined to continue it.
This marzipan stollen stays close to the firm's seasonal confectionery core and benefits from continuation bias, even if it is somewhat overshadowed by the stronger flagship raisin stollen.

Because the firm publicly framed this ancient grain bread as a newest Meisterstück and it aligns well with artisanal, traditional-quality positioning, management would usually persist unless clearer failure became visible.
